races.name: Napoleons Casino Hull Handicap

runners_data.name: Sir William
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning to form for new connections, needs the moderate pace to develop into something he can attack late
runners_data.comment: Back on form for new yard when second at Windsor off this mark 12 days ago; cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Won at Windsor (1m2f, good) for William Haggas last August; struggled on first two runs for new yard but returned to form when second of seven back at Windsor (11.5f, good) 12 days ago; first-time cheekpieces go on now.

runners_data.name: Mafting
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good current form who will track the leaders and try to outstay them in the straight
runners_data.comment: Win and second on fast ground this spring; well held at York latest but this is easier
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to crack it in 2025 handicaps but reappeared to win off a reduced mark in nine-runner race at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) this April; backed that up when second at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) and this is easier than the York Dante meeting handicap he contested last time.

runners_data.name: Sportingsilvermine
runners_data.note: Hold-up type well handicapped on old form but struggling to recapture best efforts in recent outings
runners_data.comment: Well handicapped on last year's exploits but well beaten on all four runs this year
runners_data.spotlight: Did well last spring and was placed five consecutive times last summer/autumn; now well handicapped on those exploits but beaten upwards of 8l on all four outings this year; can't rule out a revival but hard to be confident.

runners_data.name: Impartiality
runners_data.note: Course winner who runs from off the pace, carrying top weight but retains ability on his best day
runners_data.comment: Hasn't threatened in two starts this year but well treated if recapturing his 3yo form
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of his first three handicaps in 2025, including here (7.5f, good), and also went close at Glorious Goodwood (1m, heavy) off 2lb higher last July; unable to land a serious blow in handicaps at Musselburgh (1m1f) and Thirsk (1m) this spring but this is less competitive and he's too well treated to ignore; first attempt at 1m2f.

runners_data.name: Urban Glimpse
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will dictate terms from the start, returning from 28-day break under McDonald
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who showed promise in handicaps at around 1m2f last year, finishing runner-up twice on good; shaped as if needing his Goodwood reappearance after a gelding operation and remains one who should be up to winning handicaps this season; non-runner due to unsuitable ground on good to firm at Windsor earlier in the week but should have a big say if allowed to take his chance.

runners_data.name: Moonjid
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in trip after recent win, cheekpieces retained following good Nottingham effort
runners_data.comment: Came good at Nottingham last autumn but not obviously shaping as if next win is near
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a breakthrough win at Nottingham (8.3f, good); ran his best race since when fourth back at Nottingham six weeks ago (cheekpieces first time) but failed to build on it when fifth at Pontefract (1m, good to soft) last Friday; well beaten on previous attempt at 1m2f (for another yard).

races.paceDynamic: Urban Glimpse will lead from the gates with Mafting and Moonjid tracking in prominent positions, creating a measured gallop in this small field. The lack of natural pace-forcers means the tempo will be sustainable through the middle stages, setting up a tactical finish. Sir William, Sportingsilvermine and Impartiality will all need to be wound up from off the pace in the home straight. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the slow early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Urban Glimpse sets modest fractions and the pace doesn't quicken until the final 3f.
scenarios.body: The patient riders can time their challenges perfectly while the early leaders empty out. Sir William and Impartiality are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical scenario with their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Mafting and Urban Glimpse increase the tempo from halfway and sustain their efforts.
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners turn it into a staying test that blunts the finishing kicks of the hold-up horses. Mafting's stronger recent form gives him the edge in a battle with Urban Glimpse.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Urban Glimpse gets easy sectionals and kicks clear turning for home before the field reacts.
scenarios.body: McDonald times it perfectly and the field is caught napping by the change of pace. Urban Glimpse builds an unassailable lead while the closers are still getting organized.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and turns into a sprint finish from the 2f marker.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of who has the most instant acceleration rather than sustained galloping. Impartiality's track-winning experience could prove decisive in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Urban Glimpse could steal a march if he quickens the tempo suddenly turning for home while rivals are still cruising
Sir William needs cover and a clear run from his hold-up position as small fields can eliminate tactical options
Mafting's ability to sustain his effort will determine if the prominent runners can repel the late challengers
Impartiality carries a 7lb penalty from his last win here which could prove decisive in a tight finish
The pace in the first half-mile will determine everything - watch for McDonald's body language on Urban Glimpse

races.name: Hilary Needler Trophy EBF Fillies' Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Cornish Pol
runners_data.comment: Bred for further and would be a surprise winner on debut
runners_data.spotlight: £6,000 daughter of New Bay and the first foal of a twice-raced sister to 7f Group 3 winner/1,000 Guineas runner-up Lady Kaya; bred for further and would be a surprise winner on debut.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Mystery
runners_data.comment: 220,000 gns breeze-up buy; yard had impressive first-time 2yo winner for Wathnan last week
runners_data.spotlight: 220,000gns breeze-up buy; sister to 5f winner Lochaber (RPR 70) and half-sister to Enchanting Empress who was a sharp early 2yo in 2024 with a win in the Listed National Stakes at Sandown; the yard's 2yos have been doing well, including an impressive first-time-out winner in the Wathnan silks at Bath last week; market confidence behind this one could prove significant.

runners_data.name: Roots In Touche
runners_data.comment: Half-sister won two 5f Listed races last year; cost £165,000 last month; check betting
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £165,000 at the breeze-ups and bred to be sharp, being a sister to 5f winner Ancient State (RPR 75) and half-sister to last year's dual 5f 2yo Listed winner Ipanema Queen; in good hands and needs checking out in the betting.

runners_data.name: Rollthedicebaby
runners_data.comment: Chased home subsequent Listed second on 5f Goodwood debut; open to progress
runners_data.spotlight: Soldier's Call filly who made an encouraging start to her career when chasing home subsequent Marygate runner-up Armor Supreme at Goodwood (5f, good) four weeks ago; open to progress.

runners_data.name: Crystal Queen
runners_data.comment: Might have bumped into a smart one in a small-field Ayr race on debut; likely improver
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled hard but showed promise when chasing home a Royal Ascot-bound colt from the Karl Burke yard in a three-runner race at Ayr (5f, good) ten days ago; likely to improve for stable which has won this twice since 2018.

runners_data.name: The Resdev Roman
runners_data.comment: Prominent long way on 6f York debut and should progress now down at 5f
runners_data.spotlight: 80-1, prominent for long way when midfield on 6f York Dante meeting debut (good) 16 days ago; the drop to 5f could suit on that evidence and she's open to progress.

runners_data.name: Kodi Bear Light
runners_data.comment: Confirmed debut promise when making all at Thirsk (5f) a fortnight ago; should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Built on her Musselburgh debut second to Lily Agnes runner-up Hickory Lad when making all in 5f Thirsk maiden (good) a fortnight ago; the outside draw isn't ideal but there was plenty to like about the way she got things done at Thirsk and she could have plenty more to come for her leading yard.

runners_data.name: The Can Can Queen
runners_data.comment: Stepped up a good deal on C&D debut fifth when winning at Ripon; likely to improve again
runners_data.spotlight: Left her C&D debut fifth behind when winning at Ripon (6f, good) 13 days ago and the fifth gave the form a boost when going close at Redcar earlier in the week; likely to improve again.

runners_data.name: Silesia
runners_data.comment: Stepped up on debut third when second over C&D 26 days ago; may do better again
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on both starts, showing fair form when runner-up over C&D (good to soft) 26 days ago; may do better again.

runners_data.name: Moonlight Tango
runners_data.comment: Left debut behind when making all over C&D but the form isn't anything special
runners_data.spotlight: All the sharper with a run behind her when making all in a C&D maiden (good to soft) 26 days ago; that form isn't anything special but she has the potential for better again.

races.name: Beverley Two Year Old Trophy EBF Conditions Stakes (Colts & Geldings) (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Arapaho Gold
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces strong pace that should suit but must overcome traffic concerns from the rear
runners_data.comment: Overcame inexperience on Thirsk debut and the second has won since; surefire improver
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled 2.5l clear of a next-time-out winner when overcoming inexperience to make a very promising winning debut at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) four weeks ago; looks a surefire improver.

runners_data.name: Big Cigar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tactical speed perfectly placed for expected strong gallop, short break ideal
runners_data.comment: Debut winner over 6f at Newcastle recently; yard knows what it takes to win this
runners_data.spotlight: £140,000 breeze-up purchase who was sent off favourite and made no mistake on 6f Newcastle debut 11 days ago; open to progress for a yard no stranger to success in this.

runners_data.name: Blue Pete
runners_data.note: Debut runner from cold stable needs to be very good to win at this level without experience
runners_data.comment: Big ask on debut but yard has had some smart 2yos in these silks in recent years
runners_data.spotlight: 140,000gns half-brother to some quite useful winners, including as 2yos; will need to be good to make a winning debut at this level but the stable has had some very smart 2yos for these owners in recent years.

runners_data.name: Clash Of Hearts
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the pace shape, York form gives confidence for step up in class
runners_data.comment: Promise when third past post (promoted to second) on 6f York debut; likely to progress
runners_data.spotlight: Fared best of the newcomers when third past the post (subsequently promoted to second) in 15-runner novice at York (6f, good) on debut 16 days ago; likely to build on that promising start.

runners_data.name: The Dancing Pirate
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose Newmarket form has worked out well, better suited to strong pace
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite on Newmarket debut but the form has worked out and yard does well in this
runners_data.spotlight: Could manage only fourth of seven when sent off favourite on 5f Newmarket Guineas meeting debut (good to firm) but three winners have come out of that race and he's evidently well regarded by a leading stable which has won two of the last four runnings of this.

runners_data.name: Matteo
runners_data.note: Front-runner with course advantage but 37-day break and weight rise are concerns against improvers
runners_data.comment: Easy winner on C&D debut last month and bold show looks assured from inside stall
runners_data.spotlight: Coulsty colt who was way too good for his eight rivals (including Ronson) on his C&D debut (good) 37 days ago; presumably saved for this since and a bold show looks assured from the inside stall.

runners_data.name: Martial Order
runners_data.note: Prominent style helps but class looks insufficient despite powerful Burke yard support
runners_data.comment: In top hands but only sixth to Big Cigar on C&D debut and lots of improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: 11-2 when fading into sixth behind Big Cigar on his 6f Newcastle debut 11 days ago; it's of some interest that his very powerful yard is prepared to pitch him at this level but he'll require significant improvement to get heavily involved.

runners_data.name: Wait Geordie
runners_data.note: Front-runner whose Chester defeat suggests vulnerability when pace gets strong
runners_data.comment: Made all on debut before third in Lily Agnes; visor reached for now; drawn widest
runners_data.spotlight: On the back of a Bath debut success (5f, good; made all) he was sent off favourite for the Lily Agnes at Chester (5f, good again) but could only manage third after showing speed again; has a visor added now; his outside draw could make life awkward.

runners_data.name: Ronson
runners_data.note: Lead style suits but significant class deficit against these opponents despite recent course win
runners_data.comment: Well behind Matteo on C&D debut but won by 5l back here since; should be  more to come
runners_data.spotlight: 12l behind Matteo on his C&D debut but was a totally different proposition when 5l winner back here (good to firm) 18 days ago; may not have beaten much but open to further progress for a stable which has really found form.

runners_data.name: Concert Pitch
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been outclassed by Matteo twice, needs career best to feature
runners_data.comment: Placed twice over C&D but his form is well short of required standard here
runners_data.spotlight: Placed over C&D on his first two starts but no match for Matteo on debut and could only manage sixth at Windsor (6f) last week; outsider.

races.paceDynamic: Matteo, Wait Geordie and Ronson will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. The pace will be testing over this minimum trip, particularly with four horses (including Big Cigar and Clash Of Hearts) wanting prominent positions creating congestion behind the leaders. This sustained gallop will stretch the field and expose any stamina limitations. The strong pace favours horses with tactical speed who can sit handy and finish, rather than pure hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Handy
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and weaken
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will set up perfectly for horses positioned prominently but not committed to the lead. Big Cigar and Clash Of Hearts can use their tactical speed to strike when the pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets first run and controls
scenarios.body: Either Matteo or Ronson could dictate terms if they can steal a march turning for home. Their proven course form gives them the edge in a tactical battle where stamina holds out.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Arapaho Gold Arrives Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses early
scenarios.body: The hold-up horse would benefit from a stop-start affair where his class can tell. His superior rating suggests he has more ability but needs luck in running from the back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Decides
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get boxed in
scenarios.body: The congestion behind the leaders could cause major interference problems. Any horse getting a clear run while others are hampered gains a decisive advantage.

watchPoints.text: Matteo and Ronson could burn each other out if they engage in early speed duel
Big Cigar and Clash Of Hearts risk getting caught in traffic jam 2f out with four wanting prominent positions
Arapaho Gold needs significant pace collapse to get competitive from hold-up position
Blue Pete's market support will indicate connections' confidence in debut runner's ability
Wait Geordie's headgear change suggests connections seeking improvement after Chester disappointment

races.name: Birch Flooring Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Urchin
runners_data.note: Front runner with proven form advantage who should get uncontested lead and control the race from flag to finish
runners_data.spotlight: Promising third on 1m Ripon debut (good to firm) last summer and returned to make all with ease in a 1m3f novice there (good to soft) six weeks ago; that was a weak race but he could do no more than hack up and there could be plenty more to come.

runners_data.name: Who's Lope
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse still learning his trade but showed promise last time with McDonald's guidance, needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Left AW debut behind when staying-on second at Salisbury (1m2f); likely to progress again
runners_data.spotlight: Green on his debut at Kempton (1m, AW) in December; still didn't look the finished article on his recent Salisbury return (1m2f, good) but showed plenty of promise in staying on for 6l second behind a very useful type; the type to keep on improving as his stamina is drawn out (half-brother to useful 1m6f winner).

runners_data.name: Hamadhan
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer for new connections but hasn't won in over a year and faces tough task conceding weight
runners_data.comment: Fairly useful form but might be vulnerable up against two progressive sorts
runners_data.spotlight: Improved form on final Irish start (about 1m2f; AW) last September; a little below that level in two 1m4f handicaps for new yard and even a return to his best may leave him vulnerable against a couple of progressive 3yos from top stables.

races.paceDynamic: Urchin is the sole confirmed front runner in this three-horse field and will be allowed to dictate terms without early pressure from Who's Lope and Hamadhan who both prefer to come from off the pace. The lack of pace competition means Urchin can establish a comfortable rhythm through the first mile before quickening, creating an uncontested lead scenario. With both hold-up horses needing to make up significant ground in the straight, this race shape strongly favours the front runner who can control the tempo and kick clear when ready.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Urchin Controls Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Urchin gets the expected soft lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate ideal fractions and has plenty left for a decisive move approaching the straight. Both hold-up horses face an impossible task trying to reel in a horse with race-winning form who's never been headed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Late Rally
scenarios.trigger: If Urchin goes too fast early or doesn't quicken decisively
scenarios.body: The pace-setter becomes vulnerable in the final furlong allowing one of the closers to sweep past. Who's Lope showed promise at Salisbury and could time his challenge perfectly with McDonald's tactical nous.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hamadhan Finds Best Form
scenarios.trigger: If the handicapper's recent improvement continues and gets ideal pace setup
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old benefits from the strong pace and Mulrennan's experience to deliver his best performance for the new yard. His hold-up style could be perfectly suited if Urchin overdoes the early pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If all three horses fail to produce their best and it becomes a tactical crawl
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole with little between them. The most professional horse on the day prevails in a blanket finish that doesn't reflect true ability.

watchPoints.text: Urchin's early fractions - if too generous he becomes unstoppable, if too keen he's vulnerable late
Who's Lope's positioning through the first half mile as McDonald needs to have him in the right place to strike
Hamadhan's response to pressure - needs to show more spark than recent efforts to trouble these
The pace scenario developing after two furlongs will determine if this becomes a front runner's paradise
Ground conditions remain good to firm which should suit all three runners' previous best efforts

races.name: Happy Birthday Colin "Spud" Stamford Handicap

runners_data.name: Bell Shot
runners_data.note: Lone front runner with excellent course record, 10 days since last run ideal for peak fitness
runners_data.comment: Good third in 7f Kempton handicap; this three-time C&D scorer must enter calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with 6f success at Southwell and comes here on the back of a good third of 11 in 7f Kempton handicap; this three-time C&D scorer must enter calculations.

runners_data.name: Goldmoyne
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form after four-timer, strong recent Newmarket effort suggests readiness
runners_data.comment: Good fifth of 11 in 7f Newmarket handicap two weeks ago so he can't be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Completed a four-timer on the AW at Lingfield in March; posted another solid effort when fifth of 11 in 7f Newmarket handicap two weeks ago so he can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Diligent Resdev
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning to form, 21 days off may need this run after long absence
runners_data.comment: Beat one on return in Haydock h'cap after nine months off but he should strip sharper now
runners_data.spotlight: Ayr Bronze Cup winner in 2024 who also posted some good efforts without winning in 2025; beat one on his return in 7f Haydock handicap after nine months off but he should strip sharper now.

runners_data.name: Havana Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from break, course winner who should improve for recent comeback run
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; off five months before a respectable Haydock sixth; can build on it
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; back from five months off with respectable sixth of ten in 7f Haydock handicap three weeks ago; can build on it from an easing mark.

runners_data.name: Capital Guarantee
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing to bounce back from poor Thirsk effort, 5lb claimer may help
runners_data.comment: Good C&D runner-up in April but beat one in Thirsk h'cap since; needs to bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time 7f/1m winner in 2025; good C&D runner-up in April but beat only one in 1m Thirsk handicap two weeks ago; needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Billyb
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from break, 31 days off suggests rustiness after disappointing Pontefract effort
runners_data.comment: Rusty on return when eighth at Pontefract last month; took this in 2024 so not dismissed
runners_data.spotlight: Signed off for 2025 with 1m win at Southwell; looked rusty after five months off when eighth of nine in 1m Pontefract handicap last month; took this prize in 2024 so not dismissed with usual cheekpieces refitted.

runners_data.name: Roberto Caro
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in good form, consistent 6f performer stepping back up to ideal 7f trip
runners_data.comment: Has started 2026 in very good nick, third in Southwell h'cap latest; not out of things
runners_data.spotlight: Has started 2026 in very good nick, third of six in 6f Southwell handicap last month; not out of things eased 1lb.

runners_data.name: Frankies Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent 2025 record, strong Thirsk effort suggests he's ready to strike
runners_data.comment: Ended up with lot to do when good third at Thirsk two weeks ago; player off unchanged mark
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a fine 2025 when a six-time winner (from 5f to 7f); ended up with a lot to do when good third of 13 in 1m Thirsk handicap two weeks ago so he's a player off an unchanged mark.

runners_data.name: Physique
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for in-form yard, aggressive riding style may not suit tactical race
runners_data.spotlight: Has rejoined Micky Fenton and not seen to ideal effect under an aggressive ride when third of seven in 7f Yarmouth handicap 17 days ago; can make his presence felt off a 2lb lower mark here.

runners_data.name: Glenfinnan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fades late, Michael Dods stable in good form but horse needs to find more
runners_data.comment: Hinted at promise of late, set plenty to do when seventh at Thirsk latest; considered
runners_data.spotlight: Winless since August 2024 but he's hinted at promise of late, set plenty to do (also slipped on bend) when seventh of 12 in 7f Thirsk handicap two weeks ago; needs considering off a falling mark.

runners_data.name: Benacre
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who disappointed last time, quality yard suggests bounce-back possible but form concerns
runners_data.comment: In good form until just fifth at Musselburgh latest; sort to bounce back but drawn wide
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at Newcastle (7f) in February and in good form since until a below-par fifth in 7f Musselburgh handicap nine days ago; he's the sort to bounce back but drawn wide here.

races.paceDynamic: Bell Shot will control this race from the front with no genuine pace pressure, allowing him to dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages. The prominent runners Goldmoyne, Havana Blue, Roberto Caro, Physique, Glenfinnan and Benacre will settle in behind but none are aggressive early types. This creates a tactical tempo where Bell Shot can steal crucial lengths before the inevitable late surge from the hold-up horses Diligent Resdev, Capital Guarantee, Billyb and Frankies Dream. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can secure good positions without expending energy early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bell Shot Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Bell Shot gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The confirmed front runner exploits soft fractions to build an unassailable advantage, with the hold-up horses left with too much to do in the straight. His course and distance scoring record proves decisive when allowed to dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners pressure Bell Shot from the home turn
scenarios.body: Goldmoyne and Roberto Caro engage Bell Shot early in the straight, creating a pace collapse that allows the better-weighted prominent runners to prevail. The sustained gallop suits horses who can travel strongly without needing to come from too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The tactical tempo allows Frankies Dream and Diligent Resdev to unleash their finishing kicks from ideal positions. Frankies Dream's six wins in 2025 and Diligent Resdev's class edge prove decisive in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and weight tells
scenarios.body: The lightest horses Physique and Glenfinnan benefit from their weight advantage when the race becomes a pure sprint. Physique's recent return to Micky Fenton and Glenfinnan's hints of promise materialise under these conditions.

watchPoints.text: Bell Shot could steal this if allowed uncontested lead - watch for any early pressure from prominent runners
Frankies Dream had lot to do at Thirsk but showed class finishing strongly - monitor early positioning
Goldmoyne's AW form translating well to turf - watch for confident riding from in-form Oisin Orr
Diligent Resdev needs to settle better than usual given long absence - watch for early pulling
Roberto Caro dropping back to 7f from recent 6f efforts - watch for improved rhythm over this trip

races.name: ICS Cleaning Services Handicap

runners_data.name: Clear Above
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making trip debut at 1m2f with consistent recent form but needs to find improvement.
runners_data.comment: Solid third at Ripon 22 days ago; not out of things on his first go over this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Proving a consistent sort and comes here on the back of a solid third of seven in 1m Ripon handicap 22 days ago; not out of things on his first go over this trip.

runners_data.name: Bradbury
runners_data.note: Front runner with pace advantage but prone to hanging and idling when hitting the front too early.
runners_data.comment: Hung in front when second to Vietnorm at Ripon latest; 1lb better off here so big shout
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive form since switched to handicaps this season, though he hung and idled in front before being caught post when a short-head second of eight to Vietnorm at Ripon (1m2f) 22 days ago; 1lb better off here so big shout.

runners_data.name: Vietnorm
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner gelded and much improved to win last start, now faces 3lb penalty for that Ripon success.
runners_data.comment: Gained first win at Ripon latest, collaring Bradbury on post; merits serious consideration
runners_data.spotlight: Gelded and much improved when gaining a first win in 1m2f handicap at Ripon 22 days ago, collaring Bradbury on post; merits serious consideration despite 3lb rise.

runners_data.name: Wadacre Geisha
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who stepped forward significantly on handicap debut with late finishing kick over course and distance.
runners_data.comment: Improved with C&D second 18 days ago, collared late on; well in the mix nudged up 1lb
runners_data.spotlight: Study Of Man filly who took a step forward on her handicap debut when second of nine over C&D 18 days ago, collared only late on; well in the mix nudged up 1lb.

races.paceDynamic: Bradbury emerges as the only confirmed front runner in this small field, having shown pace before hanging and idling when caught on the post last time. With three hold-up horses in Clear Above, Vietnorm, and Wadacre Geisha, Bradbury will face minimal early pressure and can dictate a sustainable tempo. The lack of pace pressure means he can control fractions and avoid the front-running trap that cost him victory at Ripon. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can exploit the uncontested lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bradbury Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Bradbury settles and avoids his idling tendencies from the front.
scenarios.body: He gets an easy lead without pressure and can kick clear at the right moment, learning from his Ripon defeat where he went too early. His superior speed figures (TS:56) and control of pace dynamics give him a decisive tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the held-up trio all come with late runs simultaneously.
scenarios.body: Vietnorm and Wadacre Geisha bring the strongest recent form into a finish where positioning and timing become crucial. Vietnorm's gelding operation has unlocked improvement while Wadacre Geisha stepped forward markedly on handicap debut.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bradbury Idles Again
scenarios.trigger: If Bradbury hits the front too early and repeats his hanging/idling behaviour.
scenarios.body: His tendency to idle in front resurfaces under pressure, allowing the closers to collar him late as Vietnorm did at Ripon. The 3lb rise for Vietnorm becomes irrelevant if Bradbury gifts the race away through poor tactical execution.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Clear Above Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Clear Above finds significant improvement stepping up to this trip for the first time.
scenarios.body: His consistent form pattern suggests untapped potential at 1m2f, and Oisin Orr's booking adds confidence from connections. The longer distance suits his hold-up style if he possesses hidden stamina reserves.

watchPoints.text: Bradbury's position turning for home - if he hits the front before the furlong pole, his idling tendencies could cost him again.
Vietnorm's positioning in the small field - needs to avoid being caught too far back with limited pace to aim at.
Wadacre Geisha's early position - Connor Beasley must ensure she's not further back than last time given the lack of pace.
Clear Above's travelling - first indication of whether the trip extension will unlock improvement.
Ryan Sexton's timing on Bradbury - key to judge when to send him clear without repeating the Ripon error.

races.paceDynamic: Langholm appears the only confirmed pace-setter in this field, meaning he can dictate terms without pressure through moderate fractions over this mile and a half trip. With several prominent runners like Penny Ghent, Copper And Five, and Nakatomi likely to track within striking distance, the pace should be honest but not punishing. The lack of early speed suggests patient hold-up horses like Maple and Evelyn's Phoenix could find themselves further back than ideal on this sharp Beverley track. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front-runners who can position close to Langholm and avoid traffic in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Langholm gets soft fractions and stays the trip better than expected
scenarios.body: His early advantage becomes insurmountable as closers struggle to make up ground on the sharp track. Penny Ghent's recent front-running success makes him the main danger if positioned prominently.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to soften up Langholm in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Penny Ghent or Copper And Five can utilise their course experience and current form to strike late. Their ability to travel strongly just behind the pace becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected and creates gaps for late runners
scenarios.body: Maple's class advantage tells as he weaves through traffic, benefiting from his recent good form. Evelyn's Phoenix could also benefit if the race sets up perfectly for his style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unconsidered Runner
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites underperform and the race opens up unexpectedly
scenarios.body: Caledonian Dream's 11-month break proves beneficial rather than detrimental with his past course form. Nakatomi's recent Hamilton second suggests he's coming to hand.
